evidence.reason: `--report` is resolved and only checked against the output artifact set (lines 447-457), then written after `build()` returns (lines 462-464) without comparing it to the resolved `--repo`. A report path under the checkout can therefore create an untracked file or overwrite tracked source after any build checkout check/lock is finished, e.g. `<repo>/pnpm-lock.yaml`. Rejecting report paths contained in the resolved repo before starting the build is the smallest fix and preserves external reports; this is routine path-safety repair, not a new requirement.
